description: Fixtures for the xebench benchmarks contract 1.4 (data/benchmarks.schema.json, docs/WEBSITE-HANDOFF.md): ExecuTorch in build. Next to build.runtimes, a row may name the runtimes ExecuTorch and react-native-executorch, with engineVersion "ExecuTorch <version>" and bindingVersion "react-native-executorch <version>". Each file is a complete envelope. producerMustNotEmit=true marks a file that breaks a producer rule: scripts/validate_data.mjs refuses it. consumerExpectation is what the website does with it: the site keeps no closed runtime list, does not gate fields on the minor version and does not send build.runtimes to the client. tests/test_contract_1_4.py checks producerMustNotEmit against scripts/validate_data.mjs.

fixtures.notes: An ExecuTorch CPU row with build.runtimes ExecuTorch 1.4.1 and react-native-executorch 0.10.7
1.4 is additive: rows without ExecuTorch content are unchanged

fixtures.consumerExpectation: rendered; the runtimes are harmless (not sent to the client); engine and binding versions shown
rendered; the runtime is harmless (not sent to the client); binding version shown

fixtures.producerRule: build.runtimes names are a closed list
